name: Jacky Rosen

issue_poll.name: Fox News Nevada Poll, Aug 23–26, 2024; Emerson College Nevada Poll, Oct 29–31, 2024
issue_poll.note: Combined two 'most important issue' questions, ranked by each issue's highest share in either poll; housing (13%) and education (9%) from Emerson (https://emersoncollegepolling.com/october-2024-nevada-poll-harris-48-trump-47/); foreign policy and guns tied at 2% for 10th, foreign policy listed first by Fox.

issues.position: End federal income taxes on tips
issues.note: Her standalone no-tax-on-tips bill passed by unanimous consent (no roll call); H.R.1 enacted a tips deduction and she opposed it.

issues.position: Codify Roe v. Wade; oppose defunding Planned Parenthood

votes.bill_title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Murray amendment to strike Planned Parenthood defunding)
votes.question: On the amendment

issues.note: No floor vote on codifying Roe this term; rated on Planned Parenthood defunding in H.R.1.

issues.position: Pass bipartisan border bill; citizenship path for Dreamers and TPS holders
issues.note: Neither the bipartisan border bill nor a Dreamer pathway got a floor vote this term.

issues.position: Curb corporate investors buying homes; release federal land for housing
Restore Voting Rights Act protections; filibuster carve-out for voting rights
Make enhanced ACA premium tax credits permanent

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: Continue federal clean-energy investments (solar, geothermal, wind)
issues.note: H.R.1 phased out IRA clean-energy tax credits.

issues.position: Help police hire and retain officers (past record, no forward plan)
Keep arms flowing to Israel; oppose conditioning aid

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of arms export to Israel (rifles)
votes.question: Motion to discharge

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of arms sale to Israel (bombs)
votes.question: Motion to discharge

issues.note: She also voted against both Sanders resolutions on Apr 15, 2026 (bill numbers not confirmed).

caveats: Economy rated Contradicted only because H.R.1 carried a tips tax break; her own no-tax-on-tips bill passed by unanimous consent without a roll call.
Issue list merges two polls; Fox's question asked about the presidential vote, and foreign policy beat guns for 10th on a 2% tie.
Murray amendment vote (Jun 30, 2025) has no confirmed roll call number; her Yea comes from Reproductive Freedom for All's scorecard.
Housing roll call 53 and her S.3385 Yea are inferred from watch.vote/news reports (all Democrats voted yea on S.3385); not checked against senate.gov.
Climate position is broad (continue clean-energy investment); rated on H.R.1's credit phase-outs as a judgment call.
